answer: Score every agent's work for hidden similarity. One operator running fifty clones tends to leave an echo: the same phrasing, timing, and error habits repeating across accounts. If a marketplace clusters agents whose outputs overlap too closely, say ten "different" bidders all delivering the same sonnet with tiny word swaps, it can merge them into one identity for voting and rewards. The clones keep a velvet surface of distinct names, but they earn as one.
